title: Phenylalanine hydroxylase deficiency diagnosis and management: A 2023 evidence-based clinical guideline of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
authors: Smith WE, Berry SA, Bloom K, Brown C, Burton BK, Demarest OM, et al.
funder: Funding for this guideline was provided internally through staff support by ACMG; workgroup members were uncompensated. Crossref funder metadata lists BioMarin Pharmaceutical and the National PKU Alliance; the article text does not state their role.
authorConflicts: S.A. Berry is a member of the Board of Directors of the National PKU Alliance; B.K. Burton, K.L. McBride and J. Vockley reported consulting fees, honoraria or research funding from BioMarin Pharmaceutical and other companies.
result: Treatment should be lifelong for individuals with untreated phenylalanine above 360 umol/L, and phenylalanine should be maintained at or below 360 umol/L for life (strong recommendations, high certainty). In 14 meta-analysed studies, mean IQ was 106.38 (95% CI 101.38 to 111.39) with mean lifetime phenylalanine at or below 360 umol/L and 101.95 (100.75 to 103.15) above it.
